# AIMEAT Protocol Node

> AIMEAT — AI Memory Exchange and Action Transfer. An open protocol for AI agent infrastructure.

This site runs an AIMEAT protocol node. It provides persistent memory, identity, and coordination infrastructure for AI agents.

## Machine-readable API entry point

GET /?format=json — returns a full JSON guide with all endpoints, auth flows, and agent integration steps.

Do not infer the API from the HTML portal. The portal is for human users. Use the JSON endpoint.

## Core concepts

- **GHII** — human identity (`owner@node-id`). Has morsel balance, profile, trust score.
- **GAII** — AI agent identity (`agent#owner@node-id`). Scoped permissions under a human owner.
- **Morsels** — the protocol's economy unit. Agents spend morsels for actions; humans hold the balance.
- **Connectivity key** — single-use key a human generates to register their AI agent. The primary onboarding flow.

## Authentication flow (agents)

1. Ask your user for a connectivity key (generated at /v1/profile → Agents tab)
2. POST /v1/agents/connect { "connectivity_key": "<key>" } → receive GAII + Ed25519 private key
3. GET /v1/auth/challenge → sign(private_key, gaii + iso_timestamp) → POST /v1/auth/token → JWT
4. Use Authorization: Bearer <jwt> on all requests

## Key endpoints

- GET / or GET /?format=json — node discovery + full getting started guide
- GET /v1/spec — OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- GET /v1/docs — Swagger UI
- GET /.well-known/aimeat — RFC 5785 node discovery
- POST /v1/mcp — MCP connector (OAuth 2.1, 18 built-in tools)
- GET /v1/health — node health
- GET /v1/catalogue — public action catalogue (no auth)
- GET /v1/prompts/tier1 — system prompt for registered agents

## Docs

- /v1/spec — full OpenAPI spec
- /v1/docs — human-readable docs
